records.jp: あ！　日菜子！
records.en_original: Ah! Hinako!
records.en_auxiliary: Ah! Hinako!
records.en: Ah! Hinako!

records.jp: 香織、この前言ってたコスプレの話どうなったの？
records.en_original: Kaori! Dod you cosplay, like we talked about? How'd it go?
records.en_auxiliary: Kaori! Did you cosplay like we talked about? How'd it go?
records.en: Kaori! Dod you cosplay, like we talked about? How'd it go?

records.jp: ちゃんと衣装買って近所の友達に見せたよ
records.en_original: Yep. I bought a costume and showed my neighborhood friends.
records.en_auxiliary: Yep. I bought a costume and showed my neighborhood friends.
records.en: Yep. I bought a costume and showed my neighborhood friends.

records.jp: それで、友達の感想はどうだったの？
records.en_original: So what did they think?
records.en_auxiliary: So what did they think?
records.en: So what did they think?

records.jp: それが、みんな喜んでくれて、あたしコスプレが好きになっちゃった
records.en_original: Everyone was really happy. I love cosplay now!
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone was really happy. I love cosplay now!
records.en: Everyone was really happy. I love cosplay now!

records.jp: え！　そうなの
records.en_original: Whoa! Really?
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa! Really?
records.en: Whoa! Really?

records.jp: うん！　もっと勉強しようと思う！
records.en_original: Yup! I want to really study it!
records.en_auxiliary: Yup! I want to really study it!
records.en: Yup! I want to really study it!

records.jp: よかったね！
records.en_original: That's great!
records.en_auxiliary: That's great!
records.en: That's great!

records.jp: あっ、そろそろ時間だ
records.en_original: Oh, it's almost time.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, it's almost time.
records.en: Oh, it's almost time.

records.jp: ごめん日菜子。<CR>あたし、この後友達と約束してたんだ
records.en_original: Sorry, Hinako. I have to go meet a friend.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry, Hinako. I have to go meet a friend.
records.en: Sorry, Hinako. I have to go meet a friend.

records.jp: 仲いいんだね
records.en_original: It's nice that you get along with someone.
records.en_auxiliary: It's nice that you get along with someone.
records.en: It's nice that you get along with someone.

records.jp: いい……のかな？<CR>向こうもそう思ってくれてたらいいけど……
records.en_original: ...Get along? Well, I hope they think so.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Get along? Well, I hope they think so.
records.en: ...Get along? Well, I hope they think so.

records.jp: 友達？　さっき言ってた近所の人？
records.en_original: A friend? Do you mean one of the neighborhood people you were just talking about?
records.en_auxiliary: A friend? Do you mean one of the neighborhood people you were just talking about?
records.en: A friend? Do you mean one of the neighborhood people you were just talking about?

records.jp: うん。前から一緒にカラオケ行く約束してたんだ。<CR>最近構ってあげれなかったから、これで安心かな
records.en_original: Yeah. We've been planning to go to karaoke. I couldn't take care of them for a while, but it should be fine now.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. We've been planning to go to karaoke. I couldn't give them attention for a while, but it should be fine now.
records.en: Yeah. We've been planning to go to karaoke. I couldn't take care of them for a while, but it should be fine now.

records.jp: 構って？
records.en_original: Take care of them?
records.en_auxiliary: Give them attention?
records.en: Take care of them?

records.jp: うん。ずっと愚痴られてたから、これでようやく一息だよ
records.en_original: Yeah. They were really complaining, but they've finally let up.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. They were really complaining, but they've finally let up.
records.en: Yeah. They were really complaining, but they've finally let up.

records.jp: そう、だったんだ
records.en_original: I...see.
records.en_auxiliary: I... see.
records.en: I...see.

records.jp: （どんな友達なんだろう？）
records.en_original: (What kind of friend could they be?)
records.en_auxiliary: (What kind of friend could they be?)
records.en: (What kind of friend could they be?)

records.jp: おっと、いい加減出ないとヤバイ。<CR>それじゃまた
records.en_original: Oh, I'll be late if I don't get going. See you later.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, I'll be late if I don't get going. See you later.
records.en: Oh, I'll be late if I don't get going. See you later.

records.jp: うん……バイバイ
records.en_original: Sure... Bye bye.
records.en_auxiliary: Sure. Bye bye.
records.en: Sure... Bye bye.

records.jp: あ、ヒナちゃん！
records.en_original: Oh, Hina!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, Hina!
records.en: Oh, Hina-chan!

records.jp: ユズ。ライム。<CR>どうしたの？
records.en_original: Yuzu, Lime. What's up?
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu, Lime! What's up?
records.en: Yuzu, Lime. What's up?

records.jp: かおりん見なかった？　聞きたいことがあったんだよね
records.en_original: Did you see Kaorin? There's something we wanted to ask her.
records.en_auxiliary: Did you see Kaorin? There's something we wanted to ask her.
records.en: Did you see Kaorin? There's something we wanted to ask her.

records.jp: さっき帰ったよ。<CR>近所の友達とカラオケに行くんだって
records.en_original: You just missed her. She's off to karaoke with a neighborhood friend.
records.en_auxiliary: You just missed her. She's off to karaoke with a neighborhood friend.
records.en: You just missed her. She's off to karaoke with a neighborhood friend.

records.jp: そっかー……
records.en_original: Oh...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh...
records.en: Oh...

records.jp: どうしたの？
records.en_original: What's wrong?
records.en_auxiliary: What's wrong?
records.en: What's wrong?

records.jp: 実はね、香織ちゃんにあまりよくない噂が立ってるの
records.en_original: To tell the truth, we've been hearing some less-than-flattering rumors about Kaori.
records.en_auxiliary: To tell the truth, we've been hearing some less-than-flattering rumors about Kaori.
records.en: To tell the truth, we've been hearing some less-than-flattering rumors about Kaori-chan.

records.jp: よくない噂？
records.en_original: What kind of rumors?
records.en_auxiliary: What kind of rumors?
records.en: What kind of rumors?

records.jp: うん。かおりんが他の高校の不良とつるんで、<CR>悪いことしてるんじゃないかって
records.en_original: Apparently she's hanging out with delinquents from another high school, and they're doing some bad things.
records.en_auxiliary: Apparently, she's hanging out with delinquents from another high school, and they're doing some bad things.
records.en: Apparently she's hanging out with delinquents from another high school, and they're doing some bad things.

records.jp: ええ！？　そんな、なんで香織が！
records.en_original: What!? No way! Why would Kaori do that!?
records.en_auxiliary: What?! No way! Why would Kaori do that?!
records.en: What!? No way! Why would Kaori do that!?

records.jp: ちょっとヒナちゃん声が大きい。他の子に聞こえたらどうするの……
records.en_original: Quiet down, Hina. What if someone else hears...?
records.en_auxiliary: Quiet down, Hina. What if someone else hears?
records.en: Quiet down, Hina-chan. What if someone else hears...?

records.jp: たぶん、最近映画館とかゲーセンとかカラオケで男の子と<CR>一緒にいるのを見たって情報が多いからだと思う……
records.en_original: A bunch of people have seen her with boys at the theater, arcade, and karaoke lately...
records.en_auxiliary: A bunch of people have seen her with boys at the theater, arcade, and karaoke lately.
records.en: A bunch of people have seen her with boys at the theater, arcade, and karaoke lately...

records.jp: 友達とカラオケってしか言ってなかったけど、<CR>ちょっとそれは考えが飛躍し過ぎじゃない？
records.en_original: She said she was going to karaoke with her friend, but isn't that a pretty far off conclusion to jump to?
records.en_auxiliary: She said she was going to karaoke with her friend, but isn't that a pretty far off conclusion to jump to?
records.en: She said she was going to karaoke with her friend, but isn't that a pretty far off conclusion to jump to?

records.jp: そうだといいけどね
records.en_original: I hope you're right.
records.en_auxiliary: I hope you're right.
records.en: I hope you're right.

records.jp: なんか聞けそうなタイミングがあったら聞いてみといてよ。<CR>ヒナちゃんになら教えてくれそうだし
records.en_original: You should try asking her if you have the chance. I'm sure she would talk to you about it.
records.en_auxiliary: You should try asking her if you have the chance. I'm sure she would talk to you about it.
records.en: Try asking her when you get a chance.<CR>She'd probably tell you, Hina-chan.

records.jp: わかった……
records.en_original: Alright...
records.en_auxiliary: All right.
records.en: Alright...

records.jp: 香織――
records.en_original: Kaori...
records.en_auxiliary: Kaori?
records.en: Kaori...
